info.description:
API - SF-498 - Map Region from Lead or Account to Opportunity

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Generated: 2026-01-18
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SUMMARY:
  Map Region from Lead or Account to Opportunity

DESCRIPTION:
  As an MRD I want the Region field on an Opportunity to be automatically 
  populated from either the originating Lead or Account So that the correct 
  regional information is consistently applied across Opportunities for 
  reporting, assignment, and integration.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. Region mapped from Lead during conversion (UI only - API can't convert Leads)
  2. Region mapped from Account when Opportunity is created directly
  3. Region blank on source record - handle gracefully
  4. Consistent Region behaviour across all creation methods
  5. Region not editable after creation (if required by governance)

API TESTING REQUIREMENTS:
  - Verify Region__c field exists on Opportunity, Account, and Lead
  - Verify Region auto-populates from Account to Opportunity
  - Verify Region value is preserved correctly
  - Verify Region cannot be updated after creation (read-only)
  - Handle null/blank Region values gracefully
  - Query and verify Region values
  - Negative/boundary scenarios (invalid values)

Generated from: src/features/api/SF/SF-498.feature

This collection contains API tests for SF-498 work item.

**Note:** Region__c is a picklist field that should:
- Auto-populate from Account to Opportunity on creation
- Be read-only on Opportunity after creation
- Handle null/blank values gracefully
